summary: Verified two features end-to-end: (1) KYC 'Confirm Account Number' field — backend blocks mismatch with 400 'Account numbers do not match', frontend shows red mismatch indicator + toast and does not call API on submit; green match indicator appears when values match. (2) Welcome modal — appears once on /dashboard when sessionStorage.rt_just_signed_up matches user.id and rt_welcome_seen_<id> is absent, shows correct greeting (Welcome, Anita!), Partner ID equal to referral_code (RTUIAEE5), 3 steps, and all 3 buttons (kyc/letter/close); modal disappears on close, does NOT reappear on reload, and does NOT appear on a normal login without the flag. All 3 backend pytest tests pass. All 17 frontend assertions pass.

issues: Console a11y warnings: DialogContent is missing DialogTitle and aria-describedby. Not user-visible, but should add VisuallyHidden DialogTitle+Description for screen-reader accessibility.

action_items: (Optional / low priority) Add VisuallyHidden DialogTitle + DialogDescription inside WelcomeModal DialogContent to remove Radix a11y console warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: Profile.jsx acctMatch treats empty confirm as no-match but saveKyc allows submit only when acctMatch is true — correct behaviour. Confirm field has onPaste prevented (good UX).

Backend KycIn.bank_account_confirm is Optional; server only enforces match when it is provided. This preserves backward compat but means older/other clients could bypass the check. Consider making it required for role=customer submissions.
server.py is 1742 lines — should be split into modules (auth, kyc, campaigns, wallet, admin).
Both throwaway users must be created with lowercase email since login lowercases before lookup; documenting this here so future testers don't get stuck (see credentials note).
test_credentials: testcust@example.com / Test@1234 (untouched — KYC not submitted). Throwaway users created via pymongo with lowercase emails ('test_kyc_*', 'test_ui_*') and testcust password_hash; all deleted after tests.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral: throwaway customers inserted directly via pymongo (email_verified=true, password_hash copied from testcust). All cleaned up post-test including login_attempts.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both features work as specified. Reusable pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_kyc_confirm.py covers mismatch/match/omitted-confirm on /api/profile/kyc. IMPORTANT: when inserting throwaway users via pymongo, use LOWERCASE emails — server's /auth/login lowercases the email before find_one, so mixed-case DB emails will fail login with '4 attempts left before lock' 401. Full real /signup OTP flow was NOT tested (rate-limit risk per instructions); the sessionStorage-simulated post-signup path is verified.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional bugs found. Setup gotcha: initial test failed because throwaway user email had uppercase 'TEST_' prefix; server lowercases email at login lookup, so no match. Fixed by using lowercase prefix in fixture.
